q.en: An instrumentation amplifier (gain 201) has Vin1 = 5 mV, Vin2 = 10 mV and a common-mode voltage of 225 mV. What is Vout?

explain.en: The common-mode part is rejected: Vout = G(Vin2 − Vin1) = 201 × 5 mV = 1.01 V.
explain.vi: Thành phần chung bị triệt: Vout = G(Vin2 − Vin1) = 201 × 5 mV = 1.01 V.
